text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...
To suffer yet another defeat...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic! At this rate,
I'll completely disgrace my title as the "Empress"...!
choice_data_list: Let's use that feeling as fuel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My feelings right now... can only be summed up in one word:
"Regret."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, we cannot dwell on our defeat forever.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Forget the conversation we just had.
I merely babbled in a moment of confusion."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget this feeling,
and I'll march forward to the next victory!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...You're probably right. No matter how I struggle,
my disgraceful display is known to all."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter what is said,
past defeats will forever remain a fact...
choice_data_list: Let's rewrite history with our next victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A victory that surpasses defeat...
Are you suggesting that a crushing defeat requires an overwhelming victory to overturn it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No, dwelling on defeat forever
would be far more childish."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Back to training as soon as we return.
Tighten your focus and prepare for what's next!
